name: ユーザー・招待切替と検索フィルター帯
prompt:
Recreate only the complete Snowflake user-list toolbar shown in the primary original crop. Match its extremely wide, shallow 1738:43 aspect ratio (about 40.4:1). Do not turn it into a full page, card, or tall toolbar, and do not add vertical padding or background above or below the strip. Use the original source as the authority for geometry and spacing. No Japanese mock exists for this source.

Keep one horizontal white toolbar with subtle light-gray borders and compact 36–40 px tall controls. At the far left, preserve the two connected tabs: active white 「ユーザー」 with blue text and a light outline; inactive pale-gray 「招待済み」 with dark-gray text. To their right, show the count 「2人のユーザー」 in muted gray. Leave the wide center area blank. At the far right, keep controls in this exact order and similar widths: search input with a magnifying-glass icon and placeholder 「検索」; Owner filter with label 「所有者」 and selected value 「すべて」; Status filter with label 「ステータス」 and selected value 「すべて」; a compact square outlined refresh button with a blue-gray circular-arrow icon. Preserve source alignments, thin borders, restrained gray text, small corner radii and the large gap between left tabs/count and right filters. Do not add a heading, table, table rows, extra filters, or secondary toolbar.
reviewNotes: LH09-0258 v001 compared with the assigned Snowflake toolbar crop. It preserves Users/Invited, the 2-user count, Search, Owner All, Status All and refresh in the right order, with the intended Japanese labels. Major geometry defect: the output is 2129x739 (2.88:1) for a 1738x43 source (40.4:1), with large blank bands above and below; the toolbar content itself is about 106 px high, roughly 2.5x the source height after proportional width normalization. Prior ultra-wide attempts showed the same fixed-canvas behavior, so one attempt was used. Status: needs-correction; image-generation review only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
